title: Build pictures load faster in the X menu
summary: Browsing a builder's creations in the train editor's X menu now fills every picture on screen first, shows the big builds too, and keeps the pictures while you scroll.
highlights: Every build on screen gets its current picture before older versions start downloading. The build you select jumps the queue.
Big builds that only showed their name now show a picture.
Pictures stay loaded while you scroll and when you reopen the menu, and only download again when the build has changed.
A small arrow marks the build that is downloading.
